dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
さすがにテスト期間中ということもあり、食堂
に来ている学生も少なく、またいる人間も静か
だ。
dialogues.en:
As expected during exam week, there are only a few students
in the dining hall, and they keep quiet.
dialogues.text:
As expected during exam week, there are only a few students
in the dining hall, and they keep quiet.

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
どこでも座れそうなので、日当たりのいい席を
探していて、ふと、さくらを見かけた。
dialogues.en: Looking for a seat in the sunny area, I spot Sakura.
dialogues.text: Looking for a seat in the sunny area, I spot Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 「ここいいか？」
dialogues.en: "Is this seat taken?"
dialogues.text: "Is this seat taken?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゃ？　お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「今日は静かだな」
dialogues.en: "You're so quiet today."
dialogues.text: "You're so quiet today."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それ……けっこうひどい言い草だよ」
dialogues.en: "It's cruel to say it like that."
dialogues.text: "It's cruel to say it like that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.jp:
反応を期待してのことだったのだが、本当に、
今日はおかしなものでも食べたみたいに静か
だな。
dialogues.en:
I only said it to see her reaction, but she's super-quiet
today, as if she ate something bad.
dialogues.text:
I only said it to see her reaction, but she's super-quiet
today, as if she ate something bad.

dialogues.jp:
窓の外を眺めて、時折、思い出したように俺の
食べる姿を見ては微笑む。
dialogues.en:
Looking out of the window, she starts watching me eat, and
smiles.
dialogues.text:
Looking out of the window, she starts watching me eat, and
smiles.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり勉強のし過ぎでおかしくなったか？」
dialogues.en: "Did you lose your mind from studying too hard?"
dialogues.text: "Did you lose your mind from studying too hard?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ……やっぱり祭りと喧嘩は江戸の華な
　のかな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I think the festivals and fights are spectacular
exhibits for the city of Edo."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I think the festivals and fights are spectacular
exhibits for the city of Edo."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、本当にどうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん。皆の勉強を邪魔しちゃいけないと思っ
　てね。今日は深く静かに生きようと」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I don't want to bother other people, so I decided to
stay quiet today."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I don't want to bother other people, so I decided to
stay quiet today."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ」

そりゃ、表立って遊んでくれるヤツも少ないし
空気を感じれば騒ぎたくても騒げんもんだから
な。
dialogues.en:
Of course, not many people feel like playing around today,
and even if you wanted to be rowdy, the atmosphere wouldn't
allow it.
dialogues.text:
Of course, not many people feel like playing around today,
and even if you wanted to be rowdy, the atmosphere wouldn't
allow it.

dialogues.jp: 「難儀だな」
dialogues.en: "What a bummer."
dialogues.text: "What a bummer."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「難儀なこっただよ」
dialogues.en: "It is a bummer."
dialogues.text: "It is a bummer."

dialogues.jp: いつもより少しだけ大人っぽく笑って。
dialogues.en: She laughs in a slightly more mature way than usual.
dialogues.text: She laughs in a slightly more mature way than usual.

dialogues.jp:
さくらは陽光か俺の言葉に嬉しそうに目を細め
た。
dialogues.en:
Sakura squints. I don't know if it's against the sunlight or
the words I said, but she seems happy.
dialogues.text:
Sakura squints. I don't know if it's against the sunlight or
the words I said, but she seems happy.

dialogues.jp: ◆おすましさくら◆
dialogues.en: ◆La-di-da Sakura◆
dialogues.text: ◆La-di-da Sakura◆

dialogues.jp:
食堂でさくらを見かけるが元気がない。話を聞
くと、テスト期間中で誰も遊んでくれないらし
い。
dialogues.en:
I saw Sakura at the dining hall, but she looked very quiet.
When I asked her the reason, she said nobody would play with
her during exam week.
dialogues.text:
I saw Sakura at the dining hall, but she looked very quiet.
When I asked her the reason, she said nobody would play with
her during exam week.

dialogues.jp: そりゃそうだ……。
dialogues.en: Of course, it's to be expected.
dialogues.text: Of course, it's to be expected.
